sentences.text:
Author: N. Tukaramji
Bench: N. Tukaramji
 The Honourable Sri Justice N. Tukaramji
 Criminal Petition No.5107 of 2025
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking quashment of the proceedings in C.C.No.200218 of 2022 pending on the file of the XXII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medchal, Cybearabad against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 6.
[
2. Heard Ms.Altaf Fathima, learned counsel for petitioners, Mr.Jithender Rao Veeramalla, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent No.1-State.
3.
The petitioners are accused Nos.3 to 8 in C.C.No.200218 of 2022 facing accusation under Sections 420, 468, 471, 201 and read with 120-B of Indian Penal Code, 1860.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners would submit that though the petitioners got a strong case even for quashment, as they are determined to see the process through, the insistence for their presence is causing severe difficulty in pursuing their avocations.
Therefore, prayed for dispensing their personal appearance in the proceedings, unless presence in person is required and such direction would redress their grievance.

5. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor submits that there is no specific objection for the prayer,
however pleaded for a direction for appearance of the petitioners on the material stages in the proceedings.
6.

Having regard to the submissions, subject to the petitioners appearance through their counsel on every adjournment and the petitioners presence as and when directed by the Court, the in-person presence of the petitioners in the proceedings of the C.C.No.200218 of 2022 on the file of the XXII Additional Metropolitan Magistrate at Medchal, Cybearabad, is dispensed with.

7. With this direction, this Criminal Petition is disposed of.
